signal_clock: hourly UTC; use completed 5m premium candle ending at HH:00, then enter at exact HH:00 regular futures open
premium_signal: causal 28-day rolling z-score of hourly premium-index close; current observation excluded; minimum 90% coverage
funding_confirmation: trailing 3-calendar-day average funding must have same crowding sign as premium dislocation
directions: LONG when premium_z<=-1.5 and trailing funding<0; SHORT when premium_z>=1.5 and trailing funding>0; otherwise NO_TRADE
overlap_policy: skip new signal while symbol position remains open
funding_pnl: realized funding strictly between entry and exit; positive benefit haircut 20% under stress/severe and negative cost magnified 20%
portfolio_accounting: six equal symbol sleeves, at most one open trade per symbol
promotion_note: historical pass grants research/shadow eligibility only; never order authority
